Class HistoricalInterventionPhysicsHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.events.HistoricalInterventionPhysicsHelper
public final class HistoricalInterventionPhysicsHelper extends Object
Stateless spatial geodesy, Gaussian attenuation, and cultural-hydrographic coupling helper for HistoricalIntervention events.

    • computeHaversineDistanceKm

      public static double computeHaversineDistanceKm(double lat1, double lng1, double lat2, double lng2)
      Computes great-circle Haversine distance in kilometers between two geographic coordinates.
      Parameters:
      lat1 - epicenter latitude in degrees

    • computeSpatialAttenuation

      public static double computeSpatialAttenuation(double distKm, double radiusKm)
      Computes radial Gaussian spatial attenuation weight within radiusKm: $$w(d) = \exp\!\left(-\frac{d^2}{2\,\sigma^2}\right), \quad \sigma = \max(10,\; R / 2.5)$$
      Parameters:
      distKm - great-circle distance in kilometers
      radiusKm - maximum cutoff radius in kilometers
      Returns:
      spatial weight in [0.0, 1.0]

    • computeCoupledWeight

      public static double computeCoupledWeight(double spatialWeight, LeaderArchetype archetype, Integer cellCultureId, Integer leaderCultureId, Integer cellWatershedId, Integer leaderWatershedId)
      Computes anisotropic spatial attenuation coupled with Cultural Isogloss (Tensor 0) and Hydrographic Drainage Basin topology.
      Parameters:
      spatialWeight - isotropic radial Gaussian weight
      archetype - leader archetype governing cross-border and trans-basin friction
      cellCultureId - target cell culture identifier (null or < 0 if unspecified)
      leaderCultureId - epicenter culture identifier (null or < 0 if unspecified)
      cellWatershedId - target cell watershed identifier (null or < 0 if unspecified)
      leaderWatershedId - epicenter watershed identifier (null or < 0 if unspecified)
      Returns:
      coupled transmission weight in [0.0, 1.0]
